name: Addalock Portable Door Lock (2-pack)
caption:
Never sleep in a hotel without this. 🔒

It's a portable door lock that fits in your pocket and goes on in seconds. Once it is in, the door stays shut from the outside.

Tip: it works on doors that swing into the room, which is most hotel doors.

Comes as a 2-pack, so send one to the friend who travels the most.
